title: Sunset Sip Wine Tour
includes: Hotel pick up and drop off included

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Blending the award winning wines of one of Kelowna's top wine regions with an authentic winery restaurant experience and vineyard sunsets, our Sunset Sip tour offers a relaxing late day wine tour experience. 

This tour includes tastings at 3 award winning wineries, followed by a dinner reservation at a picturesque winery restaurant. VIP all the way, enjoy farm to table creations while taking in the sunset over the rolling vineyards, lake and mountains.

Please note, the sample itinerary provided is just an example of what to expect. Your Sunset Sip Wine Tour may be hosted in Lake Country, East Kelowna or West Kelowna as selected by VIVID Tours.
